changes.title: Nothing is typed to confirm, and faults seen on build 419
changes.detail:
Batch 57. A second pass used build 419 for real on a throwaway instance: twelve of the thirteen fixes of batch 56 were seen right. These are the faults that pass found. None of the fixes below has been seen in a browser yet.

- Confirmations: the storage page's "Apply and purge" still asked for the entity name to be typed. The owner's rule is the two keys and the slider, with nothing typed. The second step of a destructive confirmation is now always the keys and the slider, also when the caller names the thing (storage purge, media, Matter fabrics, Thread networks). The server data delete loses its type-the-name field and uses the same confirmation; the name the server wants is sent for the person. - Raw dashboard editor: the status bar was still below the window bottom. The height now allows for the inset of the page card. - Automation editor: with the side pane open, Check, Dry run and Save were hidden under it. The floating bar now keeps clear of the pane. Left-to-right only; right-to-left is not handled. - Colour naming: black was called "Deepest teal". Near-black, greys and near-white now get their own names, in English and Cantonese, with unit tests. - "Build text" is now als
changes.detail_yue: 第 57 批。屋主講明：確認只可以用兩把鎖匙加滑桿，唔准要人打字。儲存空間 頁「套用並清除」仲要打實體名，今次連根拔起：凡係破壞性確認，第二步一律 係鎖匙加滑桿。另外執咗：原始編輯器狀態列跌出視窗、自動化側欄開住時 儲存掣俾遮住、黑色俾人叫做「最深藍綠」、工具頁模板編輯器冇「砌文字」、 能源顏色名斷三行、自動化工具對話框轉分頁會跳。全部未喺瀏覽器睇。

changes.title: Fix faults found by using every feature in build 413

- Automation tools, Week ahead: a blank panel and a page error for any time trigger without a weekday list. The missing list is now read as every day. - Add from a ZIP: a theme whose name has spaces and no quotes was not recognised. A plain top-level key may now hold spaces. - Navigation pane: "Notifications" sat off-centre because an entry without a link is a native button. Every entry now starts at the start edge. The change to the older sidebar in batch 55 did nothing for this and is taken out. - People, Roles and Tags showed their title twice; the layout's own header carries the title and the summary line now. - Dashboards list: the type column and the first group header were empty until a reload, because the cached list did not depend on the translations. The note about resources no longer spills into the room kept for the add button. - A page that brings its own help icon showed two in the tool pill on wide windows; the shared one stays. - Dashboard breadcrumb no longer starts wit
changes.detail_yue: 第 56 批。搵咗兩個幫手喺 413 版逐樣功能真係用一次，搵到嘅問題一次過執： 「一週預覽」白畫面、ZIP 入面主題名有空格認唔到、側欄「通知」唔靠左、 人物／角色／標籤頁標題出兩次、儀表板清單個類型欄空白、兩粒問號掣、 選取列疊埋一齊、手機字串建構器副題被切……全部未喺瀏覽器睇， 等個映像出咗就睇。

changes.title: Fix three faults seen on build 413
changes.detail:
Batch 55. All three were seen in the browser pass on the published image.

- Overview page error "this._layoutElement.setConfig is not a function": a section or view that reused its layout element called a method on it before the element's definition had loaded. When the element has no such method yet, a fresh one is made, which is given its configuration once it is defined. - The welcome banner on the wide home page was cut by the rounded top edge of the page card. On wide windows it is now a rounded card of its own, set in from the top and the sides. The phone layout is unchanged. - "Notifications" in the navigation pane sat off-centre: a row without a link is a native button and centred its text. Rows in the expanded pane now read from the start edge like the linked ones.

Checks: full suite 7,629 passed with the 3 known build-script failures; type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors. Not yet seen in a browser; that is the next step on the published image.
changes.detail_yue: 第 55 批，執返 413 版睇到嘅三個問題：首頁嗰個 setConfig 錯誤（元件未 載入完就叫佢做嘢，而家會整返個新嘅）；闊屏首頁條歡迎橫額俾圓角切咗頭， 而家自己做張圓角卡，四邊留返位；側欄「通知」嗰行無端端置中， 而家同其他行一樣靠左。未喺瀏覽器睇，等個映像出咗就睇。
